headline_finding: ZERO labeled object-detection images (YOLO bounding boxes) exist anywhere in the project or on this machine for ANY of the 15 real Kenyan target taxa (KENYA_CANDIDATE_TAXA).
consequence: The 16.3% top-1 accuracy, 22.3% mAP@50, and T=10.0 calibration measured in Steps 4-8 are real, honest measurements of a generic 12-class insect-ID dataset (Ants, Bees, Beetles, Caterpillars, Earthworms, Earwigs, Grasshoppers, Moths, Slugs, Snails, Wasps, Weevils) from archive (1). They validate the software and benchmarking pipeline end-to-end, but provide ZERO evidence of field accuracy on Fall Armyworm, Maize Stem Borer, Potato Late Blight, or any other client target class.

foliar_disease_classification_data_found.format_limitation: All above images are single whole-leaf image classification folders. None contain bounding-box coordinates (.txt labels) required to train or evaluate an object detector like YOLO.
